- Can you confirm overall attendee list (execs + SMEs) by EOD Mon 16th? We need headcount for room setup.
- From Redwood: who will present each slot and who owns the pre-read for that topic.
- Travel constraint note: several of our presenters are arriving the evening of the 10th; if you have preferred hotel recommendations, send them over.

What I attached: agenda_draft_20260214.pdf (timeline + goals), presenter_matrix_20260214.xlsx (owner rows), and a simple travel_manifest CSV template we can populate.

Proposed agenda highlights (high level):
- Day 1 morning: exec kickoff + goals (30 min) -> vision alignment (45 min)
- Day 1 afternoon: product deep dive + integration patterns (90 min)
- Day 2 morning: workshop sessions (breakouts by use case) -> synthesis + next steps

Please flag anything missing. Once we have owners and attendee confirmation we'll finalize timing and distribute pre-reads at least 5 business days ahead.

Thanks —
